title: Ensure the organization is verified
description: Not applicable to Bitbucket Data Center: domain verification badges exist on hosted platforms to prove ownership of a public organization identity, which a self-hosted instance does not have. Carried as an explicit NA so the mapping is documented rather than missing.
remediation: No action applies to a self-hosted instance. The nearest equivalent is proving the identity of the server itself: serve Bitbucket over TLS with a certificate issued to your own verified domain.
fixSummary: No action applies to a self-hosted instance; serve Bitbucket over TLS on your own domain.
